$comment: An industry profile preselects envelopes, defaults and a process palette. It NEVER changes the thermodynamics (REQUIREMENTS.md §10) — `src/data/profiles.test.ts` asserts that a state point's computed properties are identical across all three.

profiles.name: Building HVAC
profiles.note: Room loads → RSHF line → supply airflow → mixing → coil selection. Coil face velocity 2.0–2.5 m/s and leaving RH 85–95% are the usual selection sanity checks.

profiles.name: Automotive cabin
profiles.note: The design case is transient, not steady state: pull-down from a 50–60 °C soak to 22 °C in 10–15 minutes. Fog forms when the cabin dew point reaches the inner glass temperature, which is why a cabin needs a dew point rather than a relative humidity.

profiles.name: Data centre
profiles.note: Essentially all sensible, so process lines are horizontal and W is constant. A tool that assumes a comfort-range SHR will mislead here.
